cobaltine.m: Another word for cobaltite. cobaltite: a rare silvery-white mineral; important ore of cobalt.

cobelligerent.m: Country that wages war against a common enemy, without the countries on the same side having a formal treaty of military alliance.

cobelligerents.m: More than one cobelligerent. cobelligerent: country that wages war against a common enemy, without the countries on the same side having a formal treaty of military alliance.

coble.m: A small flat-bottomed fishing boat suitable for launching from a beach, found on the north-east coast of England and in Scotland.

cobles.m: More than one coble. coble: a small flat-bottomed fishing boat suitable for launching from a beach, found on the north-east coast of England and in Scotland.
